item: R695 bound tests: roomy bound where a pass must finish
summary: The reached-every-watch test flaked on #2027: at a 0.3 s bound a loaded runner overran before the last watch. Tests whose pass must finish run at 3 s; tests whose watch sleeps past the bound check (expired on entry, expired after) == (False, True); only the statement-interrupt tests keep 0.3 s.
